name: Nelke
description: Our game's hero, who graduated at the top of her class at the capital academy. She now serves as Westwald's acting administrator.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Misty
description: Nelke's personal maid. She excels at cooking, cleaning, and bodyguard duties. She's very calm and almost never shows emotion. She is completely dedicated to Nelke.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Knoss
description: Westwald's village chief. He's physically imposing, and handles any monsters that wander into the village. Still, he's quite gentle and has a very unique way of speaking.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Lotos
description: A former tax collector and currently Westwald's development examiner. He's annoyingly cheerful and tends to appear out of nowhere.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Marie
description: An energetic girl who got the worst grades the Royal Academy has ever seen. After meeting Nelke, she decided to help Westwald and search for the Granzweit Tree.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Elie
description: An alchemist traveling with Marie. She's very detail-oriented and likes caring for others, although she's also clumsy and prone to breaking things.
sourceGame: Atelier Elie: The Alchemist of Salburg 2

name: Lilie
description: After founding an alchemy academy, she set out in search of new knowledge. Marie and Elie don't realize she comes from the same world as them.
sourceGame: Atelier Lilie: The Alchemist of Salburg 3

name: Judie
description: An alchemist that used a synthesized item to transcend worlds. She's helping Nelke while she searches for a way back to her world.
sourceGame: Atelier Judie: The Alchemist of Gramnad

name: Viorate
description: An alchemist that lived with her brother in Karotte. She excels at housework and always has a smile. She loves her village's carrots, and has an odd passion for it.
sourceGame: Atelier Viorate: The Alchemist of Gramnad 2

name: Klein
description: An alchemist from a world filled with mana. He tends not to express his emotions, although he's opened up a bit more after all of his adventures.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris: Eternal Mana

name: Lita
description: A girl from the same world as Klein. She works as a Galgazit monster hunter. She's very friendly and loves bustling areas.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris: Eternal Mana

name: Felt
description: An alchemist who travels with Viese, his childhood friend. He has a talent for alchemy, but apparently he prefers to wield his blade.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 2: The Azoth of Destiny

name: Viese
description: An alchemist who travels with Felt, her childhood friend. She's a very hard worker, and has a lot of knowledge and experience with alchemy.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 2: The Azoth of Destiny

name: Edge
description: A Raider who explores Alterworlds for a living. He's rather curt and taciturn, so people tend to misunderstand him. Nevertheless, he's quite kind at heart.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 3: Grand Phantasm

name: Iris
description: A Raider and alchemist who works with Edge. She's very upbeat and likes taking care of others. As she gets to know the others, she begins challenging herself in new ways.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 3: Grand Phantasm

name: Vayne
description: A graduate of Al-Revis Academy, a famous school of alchemy. He is quiet and avoids others, but often finds himself getting dragged into the problems of others.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Raze
description: A quiet, intense alchemist. He's a graduate of the combat program at the same academy Ulrika attended. He seems cold, but he's actually very caring.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Ulrika
description: An energetic alchemist who cares very deeply about her Mana, Uryu. Her love for Uryu tends to make her assume the worst at times, which causes problems for everyone.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Uryu
description: A young Mana. He has a fairly limited vocabulary, but can understand what is said to him just fine. In this world, he's not able to use his Mana abilities.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Rorona
description: A calm, easygoing alchemists. She tends to give people strange nicknames. One of her biggest hobbies is pie-making, and she's rather good at it.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Totori
description: An alchemist born and raised in a seaside village. She used to be somewhat quiet, but became much more confident after learning alchemy.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Meruru
description: A princess who decided to learn alchemy to bring prosperity to her homeland. She always has a smile on her face, and tends to act without thinking.
sourceGame: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland

name: Ayesha
description: An alchemist who also worked as a pharmacist at a rural atelier. She tends to move at her own pace, but is extremely committed once she makes a decision.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Escha
description: A government official working in her department's development team. She uses an archaic form of alchemy to try and spread joy. She can be a bit absentminded.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Logy
description: A government official working in his department's development team who uses a type of alchemy common to his world. He can be overly serious.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Shallistera
description: The daughter of a village chief in a remote part of the world. She may seem mild at first, but she's actually very passionate.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Shallotte
description: An alchemist with a somewhat vague dream of doing something big one day. She's energetic but tends to get herself into trouble.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Sophie
description: An alchemist traveling the world in order to help others. She's always friendly, but can also be careless sometimes.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Firis
description: A traveling alchemist from a mining town. She's friendly and curious, but will also stand her ground when necessary.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Lydie
description: The older twin sister who runs an atelier. She's kind and calm, but a bit of an airhead. She tries to be more serious, but can't help getting excited about what interests her.
sourceGame: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings

name: Suelle
description: The younger twin sister who runs an atelier. She's a tomboy who loves playing pranks. She learns quickly and can do anything well.
sourceGame: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings

name: Hagel
description: A very dependable carpenter living in Westwald. He's upbeat and energetic, and he's happy to build whatever Nelke needs.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Pamela
description: A woman living in Westwald for now. She used to be a traveling merchant, but decided to open a shop in town. She's easygoing and a little unpredictable.
sourceGame: Nelke and the Legendary Alchemists: Atelier of the New World

name: Enderk
description: The commanding officer of the Royal Guard for the kingdom of Salburg. He's quiet so people tend to see him as calm and cool.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Pepperoni
description: A fairy(?) who trains day and night to become a full-fledged fairy. He's much more muscly and tough looking compared to other fairies.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Sterk
description: A knight from the kingdom of Arland. He's a master of the blade, but he's quiet and serious to a fault, so he tends to make people afraid at first.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Bartel
description: Viorate's brother. He's kind and considerate, but is also pretty lazy, which annoys Viorate to no end. He gets nervous around women and tends to freeze up.
sourceGame: Atelier Viorate: The Alchemist of Gramnad 2

name: Norn
description: A girl with cat-like ears and a tail. She's a free spirit who doesn't like feeling tied down. She's currently trying to train as she travels so she can help her teacher.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris: Eternal Mana

name: Fairy
description: Strange beings from Fairy Village. They help alchemists, and are ranked using colors: Black, blue, green, yellow, red, purple, and white.

name: Talkative Fairy
description: None

name: Diligent Fairy
description: None

name: Rookie Fairy
description: None

name: Fairy (Water)
description: None

name: Veteran Fairy
description: None

name: Super Fairy
description: None

name: Boss
description: Leader of the fairies. He excels at battle, gathering, synthesis, and pretty much everything else. Although due to his age, he does struggle with forgetfulness.

name: Schia
description: Schia Donnerstage. The heiress of an affluent family. She is Marie's best friend, who is from the same town as her. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Kreis
description: Kreis Kuhl. Marie's former classmate. He was always at the top of the class back at the academy. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Ruven
description: Ruven Filnir. An adventurer looking for his long-lost parents. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Elie: The Alchemist of Salburg 2

name: My
description: My Sextans. A friendly female adventurer from a southern nation. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Schwalbe
description: Schwalbe Satz. A former bandit leader. After his defeat at the hands of Marie, he decided to reform and become an honest adventurer. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Ingrid
description: Marie and Elie's old teacher at their academy. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Dio
description: Dio Schenk. The owner of a tavern. He loves his daughter very much. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Flea
description: Flea Schenk. The tavern owner's daughter. She sometimes watches over the bar in her father's place. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Dornie
description: The principal of Marie and Elie's old academy. He was also once Lilie's teacher. From Atelier Marie.
sourceGame: Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg

name: Eisel
description: Eisel Weimar. Elie's colleague and a fellow alchemist. She is a sophisticated aristocrat who taught Viorate alchemy during their travels. From Atelier Elie.
sourceGame: Atelier Elie: The Alchemist of Salburg 2

name: Nordis
description: Nordis Fuba. A classmate of Elie's that entered the academy at the top of his class. He is generally friendly and relaxed. From Atelier Elie.
sourceGame: Atelier Elie: The Alchemist of Salburg 2

name: Hermina
description: An academy teacher who focuses on research into poisons, homunculi, and other strange magic. From Atelier Elie.
sourceGame: Atelier Elie: The Alchemist of Salburg 2

name: Sphere
description: A girl who once suffered from amnesia. She was able to regain her memories after her adventures with Judie. From Atelier Judie
sourceGame: Atelier Judie: The Alchemist of Gramnad

name: Lapis
description: A mysterious girl that lived in Viorate's home. From Atelier Viorate
sourceGame: Atelier Viorate: The Alchemist of Gramnad 2

name: Nanami
description: Nanami Schmidt. A girl with great mercantile talents. She runs her own general store. From Atelier Viorate.
sourceGame: Atelier Viorate: The Alchemist of Gramnad 2

name: Zeldalia
description: None

name: Nel
description: Nell Ellis. A girl who works as a Raider with her sister Yula, trying to rebuild their family name. From Atelier Iris GP.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 3: Grand Phantasm

name: Ana
description: Annastra Servatika. An introverted girl who works as a receptionist at the Raider's Guild. From Atelier Iris GP.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 3: Grand Phantasm

name: Phenyl
description: Phenyl Neet. A receptionist at the Raider's Guild. She hates how short she is. From Atelier Iris GP.
sourceGame: Atelier Iris 3: Grand Phantasm

name: Jess
description: Jessica Philomele. A classmate of Vayne's. She's always friendly and cheerful. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Flay
description: Flay Gunnar. An older schoolmate of Vayne's. He was always considered the school's biggest troublemaker, but then went on to become the dean. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Roxis
description: Roxis Rosenkrantz. A member of a famous alchemist family. He tends to be sarcastic and a little smug. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Anna
description: Anna Lemouri. A younger schoolmate of Vayne's. She's a master swordfighter. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Nikki
description: Nicole Mimi Tithel. A beastgirl in the same grade as Vayne. She's eternally cheerful. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Muppy
description: Muppy Oktavia Wonderchak VIII. A mysterious creature from outer space. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Isolde
description: Isolde Schelling. A lecturer at Vayne's academy who knows the secret behind Vayne's birth. From Mana Khemia.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia: Alchemists of Al-Revis

name: Lily
description: Liliane Vehlendorf. The master that Raze serves. From Mana Khemia 2.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Whim
description: Whim. A Mana that has made a pact with Lily. From Mana Khemia 2.
sourceGame: Mana Khemia 2: Fall of Alchemy

name: Cordelia
description: Cordelia von Feuerbach. Rorona's childhood friend. She's very reliable and loves taking care of others, but she also has a short fuse. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Lionela
description: Lionela Heinze. A puppeteer and street performer. She has two puppets that literally have a mind of their own. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Iksel
description: Iksel Jahnn. Rorona's childhood friend and a talented cook. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Gio
description: Ludwig Giovanni Arland. Arland's 13th king. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Tiffani
description: Tiffani Hildebrand. A widow that runs a general store. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Esty
description: Esty Dee. An inspector in Arland and Gio's personal watchdog. She also outranks Sterk. From Atelier Rorona.
sourceGame: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland

name: Gino
description: Gino Knab. Totori's childhood friend who's aiming to become the best adventurer in the world. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Melvia
description: Melvia Siebel. An adventurer from Totori's village. She's always very cheerful and optimistic. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Mimi
description: Mimi Houllier von Schwarzlang. Totori's best friend and a fellow guild adventurer. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Marc
description: Marc McBrine. The self-proclaimed greatest genius scientist in the world. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Ceci
description: Cecilia Helmold. Totori's sister. She has a kind, motherly personality. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Gerard
description: Gerhard Konev. A middle-aged gentleman that works as a barkeeper in Aranya. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Chim
description: A young boy homunculus Rorona created for Totori. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Chim
description: A young girl homunculus Rorona created for Totori. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Piana
description: A girl from Frontier Village. From Atelier Totori.
sourceGame: Atelier Totori: The Adventurer of Arland

name: Keina
description: Keina Swaya. Meruru's personal maid, who has also been her friend since childhood. From Atelier Meruru.
sourceGame: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland

name: Rufus
description: Lias Falken. Meruru's butler and tutor. From Atelier Meruru.
sourceGame: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland

name: Filly
description: Filly Dee. The receptionist for the Arland Adventurer's Guild. From Atelier Meruru.
sourceGame: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland

name: Nio
description: Nio Altugle. Ayesha's sister. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Keithgriff
description: Keithgriff Hazeldine. An alchemist traveling the land in search of truth. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Juris
description: Juris Gruden. A young warrior that makes a living by hunting. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Odelia
description: An automaton and librarian at Zweiteturm, the world's greatest library. She now serves as Keithgriff's attendant. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Harry
description: Harry Olson. The owner of a large trading company. He's quite eccentric and travels in search of treasure. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Marietta
description: Marietta Muir. A clerk at a general store owned by Harry's trading company. From Atelier Ayesha.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Ernie
description: Ernie Lyttleton. A traveling merchant who does business all around the world. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Nanaca
description: Nanaca Gruden. Juris's sister. She's a cattle rancher by trade who travels the world searching for the best feed possible. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk

name: Awin
description: Awin Sidelet. Escha's cousin and an air balloon mechanic. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Reyfer
description: Reyfer Luckberry. An easygoing treasure hunter. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Katla
description: Katla Larchica. A calculating street vendor. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Linca
description: The development team chief's assistant and Marion's former bodyguard. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Marion
description: Marion Quinn. The development team's Corseit Branch Chief. She used to be an official in the central bureau. From Atelier Escha & Logy.
sourceGame: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky

name: Wilbell
description: Wilbell Voll-Ersleid. A woman from a family of witches. She became Shallotte's alchemy teacher due to a misunderstanding. From Atelier Shallie.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Jurie
description: Jurie Crotze. A cool-headed treasure hunter. She loves her younger sister very much. From Atelier Shallie.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Miruca
description: Miruca Crotze. An even-tempered alchemist. She is also Shallotte's childhood friend and Jurie's sister. From Atelier Shallie.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Rosemia
description: A Dusk Sea collector that wanders the land. From Atelier Shallie.
sourceGame: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

name: Plachta
description: An old book that once belonged to Sophie's grandmother. She now has the form of a human. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Monika
description: Monika Ellmenreich. Sophie's childhood friend who always made the honor list. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Oskar
description: Oskar Behlmer. Sophie's childhood friend who has the ability to talk to plants. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Fritz
description: Fritz Weissberg. A traveling puppeteer who is also Drossel's father. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Corneria
description: A girl with the ability to copy objects. She currently runs a trading company. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Leon
description: Amelia Leonmeyer. An excellent tailor who has won multiple competitions. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Tess
description: Tess Heitzmann. A girl that likes to wear a bunny ear headband. She's basically the mascot of the cafe she works at. From Atelier Sophie.
sourceGame: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book

name: Liane
description: Liane Mistlud. Firis's sister who works as a hunter. From Atelier Firis.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Ilmeria
description: Ilmeria Von Leinweber. Firis's best friend and rival. She's a truly amazing alchemist and also acts as Lydie and Suelle's teacher. From Atelier Firis.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Drossel
description: Drossel Weissberg. A traveling playwright and Fritz's daughter. From Atelier Firis.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Revy
description: Revy Berger. A wandering swordsman who is on a journey to become even stronger. From Atelier Firis.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Angriff
description: Angriff Dahlmann. An old mercenary with an energetic, dynamic personality. From Atelier Firis.
sourceGame: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey

name: Lucia
description: Lucia Borthayre. Lydie and Suelle's childhood friend and rival alchemist. From Atelier Lydie & Suelle.
sourceGame: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings
